name: IndustrialGuard AI — 4-Agent Quality Control Pipeline
description: Agentic manufacturing quality control workflow. Implements IBM Problem Statement #37: Process Monitoring → Quality Analysis → Defect Prediction → Process Optimization, grounded in IBM Granite + RAG knowledge base.
note: Gate A pending: IBM watsonx.ai access not yet provisioned. This workflow file is ready for import once credentials are confirmed (see DECISION_LOG.md DECISION-001). Use USE_CACHED_GRANITE_RESPONSES=true for demo mode without IBM API.

nodes.description: Receives raw manufacturing process parameter payload. Keys must match trained feature names: air_temperature, process_temperature, rotational_speed, torque, tool_wear.

record_json.info: JSON object with process parameters. Example: {"air_temperature": 301.2, "process_temperature": 311.8, "rotational_speed": 1395.0, "torque": 64.5, "tool_wear": 218.0}

record_id.info: Optional client-provided identifier. Auto-generated if not provided.

data_source_label.info: Provenance label: REAL PUBLIC DATA | SYNTHETIC DATA | SIMULATED STREAM | USER-PROVIDED DATA

nodes.description: Validates physical parameter bounds, detects statistical anomalies (IQR + Isolation Forest), and forwards structured monitoring output downstream. Never uses LLM for anomaly detection.

node.description: Calls: agents.monitoring.process_monitoring_agent.run(record, record_id). Returns structured ProcessMonitoringOutput with anomaly_detection sub-object.

backend_url.info: FastAPI backend endpoint. Used to log results to database.

nodes.description: Statistical deviation analysis, IQR violation detection, correlation analysis, and Root-Cause Analysis (RCA). Queries ChromaDB RAG store for supporting documentation. Calls IBM Granite for narration only — not for numerical analysis.

node.description: Calls: agents.quality_analysis.quality_analysis_agent.run(monitoring_output). RCA is a capability of this agent — not a separate 5th agent.

rag_top_k.info: Number of ChromaDB passages to retrieve per query.

nodes.description: Retrieves relevant manufacturing knowledge from the 3-tier ChromaDB vector store (12 chunks, default embedding). Used by Quality Analysis and Optimization agents.

node.description: Calls: rag.retrieval.retriever.retrieve(query, top_k). Sources: Tier 1 (ISO 13374), Tier 2 (Tool Wear Guide), Tier 3 (Demo SOP). Returns passages with source + tier labels.

nodes.description: Runs the trained XGBoost v1.0 model (Test F1=0.8217, PR-AUC=0.9198, ROC-AUC=0.9755) on scaled feature vector. Computes local SHAP attributions. Never uses LLM for prediction.

node.description: Calls: agents.defect_prediction.defect_prediction_agent.run(quality_output). Model: ml/models/defect_predictor_v1.0.pkl. Features: air_temperature, process_temperature, rotational_speed, torque, tool_wear.

defect_threshold.info: Configurable threshold. Default 0.5. Adjust based on precision/recall tradeoff requirements.

nodes.description: Generates traceable corrective recommendations using 3 evidence-based methods ONLY: (a) rule-based operating ranges, (b) historical low-defect comparison, (c) what-if model inference. LLM narrates — never invents numerical values.

node.description: Calls: agents.optimization.process_optimization_agent.run(defect_output). Recommendations saved to DB as AWAITING_REVIEW — human engineer must approve/reject via /api/recommendations/{id}/review.

enable_what_if.info: Perturbs features through trained model to estimate probability change from parameter adjustment.

recommendation_limit.info: Maximum number of recommendations to surface per record.

nodes.description: IBM Granite model for natural-language narration, RAG synthesis, explanation generation, and report generation. Model ID: ibm/granite-guardian-8b. Endpoint: https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com. NEVER used for numerical calculations or predictions.

node.description: Calls: backend.services.granite_client.generate_narrative(task, context). Credentials from .env: WATSONX_API_KEY, WATSONX_PROJECT_ID. Set USE_CACHED_GRANITE_RESPONSES=true for demo/CI mode.

model_id.info: IBM Granite model identifier. Do not change without updating DECISION_LOG.md.

temperature.info: Low temperature for factual narration. Do not increase above 0.4.

nodes.description: Aggregates outputs from all 4 agents into the final PipelineResult JSON. Persists to SQLite database via FastAPI backend. All recommendations stored with status=AWAITING_REVIEW.

node.description: Returns: {pipeline_run_id, timestamp, final_status, final_risk_level, final_prediction, final_recommendations, stages: {process_monitoring, quality_analysis, defect_prediction, process_optimization}}

edges.description: Raw parameter payload to Process Monitoring Agent
Structured monitoring output (NORMAL/CAUTION/CRITICAL + anomaly detection) to Quality Analysis Agent
Quality analysis generates retrieval query from top contributing features
Retrieved knowledge passages augment quality analysis RCA
Quality analysis report (contributing factors, anomaly summary, RAG evidence) to Defect Prediction Agent
Defect prediction (class, probability, SHAP, risk level) to Process Optimization Agent
Structured context (anomalies + prediction + recommendations) to Granite for narration only
Full optimization output including recommendations (AWAITING_REVIEW) to pipeline aggregator

gate_a_status.note: IBM watsonx.ai access not yet provisioned. Workflow runs in cache mode (USE_CACHED_GRANITE_RESPONSES=true). Once IBM API key and project ID are configured in .env, set USE_CACHED_GRANITE_RESPONSES=false to enable live Granite calls.

agent_communication_protocol.note: All inter-agent communication uses structured JSON — never free text. Schema validated by Pydantic at API boundary. See agents/orchestrator/pipeline.py for full schema.

human_in_the_loop.note: No recommendation results in automated machine actuation. Human engineer must review and approve/reject via the dashboard or API before any process action.
